en.bdb: The Creator is detached and perfect

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: paravadhagaar salaaheeaai siraTh upaiee ra(n)g bira(n)gee|

en.bdb: That sustainer Lord ought to be praised who has created the multicoloured creation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਿਕੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਹਿਦਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਣਮੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: raajik rijak sabaahidhaa sabhanaa dhaat kare anama(n)gee|

en.bdb: He is bestower of livelihood to everyone and giver of charity unasked for.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਜਿਵੇਹਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੰਦੀ ਚੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: kisai jivehaa naeh ko dhubidhaa a(n)dhar ma(n)dhee cha(n)gee|

en.bdb: None resembles anyone and the jiva (creative) is good or bad according to the ratio of perplexity in him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਲੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham niralep hai pooran braham sadhaa sahala(n)gee|

en.bdb: Being transcendent, He is detached from every thing and being perfect Brahm. He is always with everybody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਰਬੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa sabhanaa a(n)dhar hai saraba(n)gee|

en.bdb: He is beyond caste and symbols etc. but side by side He pervades one and all.
He is in air, water and fire i.e. He is the power of these elements.
